title: a results page saved for a fetch step's own search
line: a results page is told from a record page by the parser that claims it, never the file name, and goes to the fetch step whose citation was searched for by that name in that collection, as the run's own artifact with the query as run: none when no row fits, the rows kept on the artifact, the step planned, the page filed under the tree; the same page saved again is a repeat and stays in the inbox

steps.say: the search saved, under a name of the owner's own

expect.why: read as a results page by its own markup; it fulfils the fetch step whose citation was searched for by this name in this collection; the page names her only as a mother with no dates, so no row fits and the run is none
the step's log row: none, the reason and the count in its note, the query as run, the page as its artifact
archived under the holder with the search URL as locator
a none run leaves the step planned
the twenty rows stay on the artifact as candidates
the page leaves the inbox, filed under the tree

steps.say: the same search saved once more, other bytes, the same rows

expect.why: a repeat is left in the inbox
the repeat logs no second run
